paper.abstract_en: We construct an algebra of observables associated to a cut of null infinity in asymptotically flat spacetimes. The Bondi mass associated with a sharp cut of future null infinity is not a well-defined quantum operator: its fluctuations diverge even after smearing in retarded time. We instead introduce a finite-radius, time-smeared version of the Bondi mass and adjoin this operator to the matter and graviton observables in an arbitrarily small asymptotic neighborhood of the cut. We separately analyze spacetimes with and without black holes and find, in both cases, Type III$_1$ von Neumann algebras that satisfy non-trivial nesting relations. In Minkowski spacetime, the resulting algebra reconstructs the spacelike wedge associated with the cut. In a stationary black hole spacetime, it reconstructs the region bounded by the cut and the black hole bifurcation surface, providing an asymptotically flat analogue of an entanglement wedge. In the limit as the cut is moved to past infinity, we recover a Type I$_{\infty}$ algebra for spacetimes without black holes and a Type II$_{\infty}$ algebra for black hole spacetimes. For algebras at finite cuts of retarded time, we construct a Type II$_\infty$ regularization of the black hole algebra whose renormalized von Neumann entropy agrees with the generalized entropy. In appendices, we prove two technical results about quantum fields, in a Schwarzschild spacetime, that asymptote to the Minkowski vacuum at infinity: a split property for unbounded, spacelike separated regions and the construction of a faithful, normal, and semifinite Hartle-Hawking weight whose modular flow is Schwarzschild time evolution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将全息方法应用于渐近平坦时空中的黑体热力学，包含对纠缠熵和代数结构的深入分析，理论深度高且方法严谨，尽管新颖性适中，但对相关领域有重要贡献。
decision.title_zh: 零无穷远处的全息代数
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了一个与渐近平坦时空中零无穷远处的一个切口相关联的可观测代数。与未来零无穷远处的尖锐切口相关联的邦迪质量不是一个定义良好的量子算符：即使在延迟时间中涂抹后，其涨落也会发散。相反，我们引入了邦迪质量的有限半径、时间涂抹版本，并将该算符附加到切口任意小的渐近邻域中的物质和引力子可观测项上。我们分别分析了有和没有黑洞的时空，并在两种情况下都发现满足非平凡嵌套关系的III型$_1$冯·诺依曼代数。在闵可夫斯基时空中，所得的代数重构了与切口相关联的类空楔形。在静态黑洞时空中，它重构了由切口和黑洞分叉面界定的区域，提供了渐近平坦的纠缠楔形的类比。在切口移动到过去无穷远的极限中，我们为没有黑洞的时空恢复了I型$_\infty$代数，为黑洞时空恢复了II型$_\infty$代数。对于延迟时间有限切口的代数，我们构造了黑洞代数的II型$_\infty$正则化，其重整化冯·诺依曼熵与广义熵一致。在附录中，我们证明了在史瓦西时空中渐近于无穷远处闵可夫斯基真空的量子场的两个技术性结果：无界类空分离区域的分裂性质，以及一个忠实、正规、半有限的Hartle-Hawking权的构造，其模流是史瓦西时间演化。
